prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `fib_mod(n, modulus)` in src/lib.rs, returning the `n`-th Fibonacci number with `F(0) = 0` and `F(1) = 1`, reduced modulo `modulus`. Return `None` when `modulus == 0`. `n` may be as large as one billion, so use fast doubling rather than a linear loop. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
